checks.mismatch: Amount differs from what is due

home.title: Finance overview
home.description: The queues of every finance desk you work, with counts and SLA. Every number drills down to its source document.
home.noQueuesTitle: No finance queues for your role
home.noQueuesBody: You can still open the reports and documents your role allows from the side menu.
home.approvalsNote: A requester can never approve their own request (segregation of duties).
home.noApprovals: No finance requests are waiting for you

slips.title: Slip review
slips.description: Transfer slips the automatic check could not pass. Finance reviews each within 4 business hours (D-061), earliest deadline first.
slips.emptyBody: Slips that pass the automatic check confirm the payment without waiting for Finance.

review.title: Review slip {code}
review.description: Compare the slip with the amount due, then approve with the bank's transaction reference or reject with a reason.
review.bankTransRefHint: From the incoming line on the bank account; used to catch duplicate slips.
review.receivedAmountHint: Leave empty if the slip's amount was received.
review.rejectNote: Reason for rejecting (the customer sees it)
review.badAmount: Enter the amount as a number
review.needNote: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
review.readOnly: You can see the slip; approving it is Finance's job.
review.confirmApproveTitle: Approve the slip and take the payment
review.confirmApproveBody: Take {amount} for {code}, bank reference {reference}. The tax invoice / receipt is issued and posted (P02) straight away.
review.confirmRejectBody: The slip for {code} will not count as payment; the customer is asked for a new one.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Every payment the books have recorded: gateways, slips, credit-term transfers and store credit.
payments.search: Search by reference, order or order group

refunds.title: Customer refunds
refunds.description: Every refund is approved by a Finance Manager other than the requester; a bank-transfer refund is then recorded by another Finance user with its reference (D-169).

request.title: Request a refund of {reference}
request.description: Give the amount, channel and reason; the request waits for a Finance Manager.
request.makerChecker: Whoever requests a refund can neither approve it nor record its payout.
request.amountHint: The API checks it is within what can be refunded.
request.needAmount: Enter the amount as a number, e.g. 350 or 350.50
request.needReason: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
request.confirmBody: Refund {amount} of payment {reference}. The request waits for a Finance Manager's approval.
request.sent: Refund requested — waiting for a Finance Manager

detail.title: Refund request
detail.waiting: Waiting for a Finance Manager's approval
detail.notYoursBody: Another Finance user records the transfer (segregation of duties).
detail.referenceHint: The reference the bank gave the outgoing transfer.
detail.confirmBody: Confirm {amount} was transferred back, reference {reference}. The refund is posted (P22) straight away.

documents.title: Customer document registers
documents.description: Issued by Collective Group (Thailand) under the Packio brand. Numbers run without gaps in each series; a voided document keeps its number and its reason.
documents.search: Search by number, order, buyer or tax id

detail.title: Customer document
detail.voided: This document was voided (its number is kept)
detail.links: Where it comes from and goes
detail.journalsNote: Every line opens its journal, posting rule, event and the people who made and checked it.
detail.voidBody: Void {number} for {amount}. The number is kept with the reason and its journals are reversed.

resend.title: Send {number} to the customer again
resend.description: Sends the same PDF; no new document is issued.
resend.line: LINE (when the customer has linked it)
resend.otherAddressHint: For example the customer's accounts team. Leave empty to use the customer's own.

debit.title: Issue a debit note against {number}
debit.description: A debit note adds to what the customer owes. VAT is charged at the original tax invoice's rate.
debit.netHint: VAT is worked out for you.
debit.needNet: Enter the amount as a number
debit.needNote: Give details of at least 3 characters
debit.confirmBody: Add {amount} net against {number}. It takes the next number in the debit note series.
debit.failed: Could not issue the debit note

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.description: Credit notes requested and what became of them. A credit note is numbered and posted only once a Finance Manager other than the requester approves it (D-169).
creditNotes.search: Search by order code or details

wizard.title: Request a credit note
wizard.description: A credit note always refers to a tax invoice and uses a reason from the statutory list.
wizard.searchHint: Type a document number, order code or buyer name (at least 2 characters).
wizard.kindHint: Each kind maps to its statutory reason.

kindHints.shortage: Short, but within the agreed tolerance (D-080)
kindHints.claim: Defective or off-spec, per the claim decision
kindHints.cancellation: Cancelled after the deposit, before production
kindHints.price_reduction: A lower price for the goods or service
kindHints.discount: A discount given after the sale

wizard.reasonHint: Change it if another reason on the list fits better.
wizard.amountHint: No more than was invoiced less earlier credits; the API checks it again.
wizard.settleToHint: Cash back is a separate refund request.

settlementHints.store_credit: Used against the next order, or refunded later
settlementHints.receivable: Reduces what is still owed on this order

wizard.refundBody: Issue the credit note to store credit first, then request a refund from the payment. The refund is approved separately.
wizard.needAmount: Enter the amount as a number, e.g. 1284 or 1284.00
wizard.needNote: Give details of at least 3 characters
wizard.approvalTitle: Needs approval before it is issued
wizard.approvalBody: The request waits for a Finance Manager other than you; the credit note is numbered and posted once approved.
wizard.sent: Credit note for {order} requested — waiting for approval
wizard.failed: Could not request the credit note

items.title: Trade receivables
items.description: What customers and companies still owe, by due date. A company more than 7 days overdue cannot place credit orders (D-122).
items.search: Search by document, customer, company or order
items.writeOffBody: Write off {number} of {party}, {amount} open. The request waits for a Finance Manager.
items.writeOffReason: Reason and the collection effort made

aging.title: Receivables aging
aging.description: What is open by how long it is past due, at the chosen date. The totals come from the books.

allowance.title: Allowance for doubtful accounts
allowance.description: Brings the allowance to a target at a date; only the change is posted (P30). With rates set by age band, no amount is needed.
allowance.targetHint: Leave empty to use the configured rates (if any).
allowance.badAmount: Enter the amount as a number
allowance.confirmTitle: Update the allowance for doubtful accounts
allowance.confirmBody: Set the allowance at {asOf} to {amount}; only the change is posted.
allowance.confirmBodyRates: Set the allowance at {asOf} from the configured rates.

wht.title: Withholding certificates (50 Tawi) from customers
wht.description: Chase the certificates customers owe for tax they withheld until they arrive, then record the number, the date and a copy.
wht.search: Search by customer, company, receipt or certificate number
wht.waiveBody: Stop chasing the certificate for {number}, {amount} withheld. Give a reason that can be checked.

recordForm.title: Record the certificate for {number}
recordForm.copyHint: PDF or image up to 20 MB, kept as a financial record.
recordForm.drop: Drop a file here or choose one
recordForm.wrongType: {name} is not a PDF or an image
recordForm.needDate: Enter the date on the certificate

statements.title: Company monthly statement
statements.description: Every credit-term order up to the chosen month, what was paid and what is still open, for consolidated payment (D-125).

dunning.title: Payment reminders
dunning.description: Reminders sent to customers 7 days before the due date, on it, and after it (D-122).

party.title: Receivable balance
party.storeCreditNote: Credit from credit notes, used against orders or refunded in cash.

journals.title: Journal {number}
journals.description: Every journal entry. Posted entries cannot be edited; a correction is a reversing entry linked to the original.
journals.caption: Journals of this document
journals.search: Search by entry number, description or source number
journals.noLedgerAccess: You do not have access to the general ledger
journals.trailNote: The source document, the system event, the posting rule, the maker and the checker.

open.title: Open payables
open.description: What Packio owes, net and VAT separately, with the date each becomes payable under the payout policy frozen on its PO (D-022, D-164).
open.search: Search by vendor, PO or order

purchaseOrders.title: Factory purchase orders
purchaseOrders.description: One per production job released to a factory, at the price and payout policy frozen at release.
purchaseOrders.search: Search by PO, job or order

goodsReceipts.title: Goods receipts
goodsReceipts.description: Recorded from the POD and the reconciled quantity; the factory is paid for the lower of delivered and ordered (D-165, P15).
goodsReceipts.search: Search by GR or PO number

statements.title: Factory billing statements
statements.description: Packio generates the statement from PO and delivery for the factory to confirm; the factory then issues its own tax invoice (D-090).
statements.capture: Record a tax invoice for the factory
statements.missingInvoiceBody: Input VAT on this statement cannot be claimed until the factory's valid tax invoice is recorded.

capture.title: Record the tax invoice for {number}
capture.description: For a tax invoice the factory sent by other means. It is the factory's own (its number and its name) and is validated separately.
capture.fromStatement: Filled from the statement; make it match the invoice itself.
capture.needNumber: Enter the tax invoice number and date
capture.saved: Tax invoice recorded — waiting to be checked
capture.drop: Drop a file here or choose one

invoices.title: Tax invoices and vendor bills
invoices.description: Factories' tax invoices against their statements, and other vendors' bills. Input VAT is claimable only with a valid tax invoice.
invoices.search: Search by number, vendor or statement
invoices.checksNote: The seller must be the factory (tax id and branch) and the amounts the statement's.
invoices.validateBody: Validate {number}. Its input VAT of {vat} becomes claimable, and VAT paid while it was missing moves out of the pending account (P17V).
invoices.rejectBody: Reject {number}. The factory sees the reason and sends a correct one.

vendorsPage.title: Vendors
vendorsPage.description: Factories from partner onboarding, and the others — carriers, freelance designers, service vendors.

vendors.title: Vendor master
vendors.description: The withholding form follows the juristic type (individuals PND 3, others PND 53).

banks.title: Payout bank accounts
banks.note: A change is never an edit: the new account waits for two approvers (Finance, then Finance Manager) and a call-back on the number already on record before it is paid into.
banks.factoryNote: Factories propose changes in their portal or through the Partner team; Finance approves and calls back here.

create.title: Add a vendor
create.description: A vendor that is not a factory — a carrier, a designer, a service. Factories come from partner onboarding.
create.name: Registered name
create.juristicHint: Individuals file PND 3; companies and partnerships PND 53.

propose.title: Change the payout account of {vendor}
propose.description: The new account is used after two approvers and a call-back. The number is stored encrypted and only its last 4 digits are shown.
propose.name: Account name
propose.badNumber: Enter a valid account number and name
propose.confirmBody: Change the payout account of {vendor} to the one ending {last4}. Two approvers and a call-back are needed before it is used.

call.title: Record the call-back for the account ending {last4}
call.description: Who called, which number, when, and what came of it.
call.rule: Call the number already on record — never one given in the change request.
call.needCall: Enter the number and the time of the call

bill.title: Record a bill from {vendor}
bill.description: As an expense, cost or asset; input VAT only on a valid tax invoice. Whoever records this vendor's bills cannot change its bank account.
bill.taxInvoiceHint: It carries the vendor's tax id and branch
bill.noVat: Not a tax invoice: no input VAT
bill.needHeader: Enter the bill number and date
bill.needLines: Give every line an account, a description and amounts

payouts.title: Factory and vendor payout runs
payouts.description: Finance builds a run from what is payable and proposes it; a C-Level other than the proposer approves; then the bank file goes out and the bank's result is recorded (D-022, D-166).

create.title: New payout run
create.description: Collects the payables due by the pay date, per vendor and kind. The run stays a draft until it is proposed.
create.rulesBody: Withholding per line type (hire of work, transport, services), retention held on balances, and vendors without a verified account left out.
create.nothing: Nothing is payable by this date

detail.title: Payout run {run}
detail.waitingBody: A C-Level other than the proposer approves it.
detail.waitingProposer: You proposed this run, so you cannot approve it.
detail.rejectedBody: Its payables wait for the next run.
detail.excludedBody: Their vendors have no verified payout account yet; they stay in the exceptions until one is ready.
detail.proposeBody: Propose run {run}, transferring {cash} in total, for a C-Level's approval.
detail.generateBody: Generate the {format} file of run {run}, transferring {cash} in total. The file is kept as a financial record.
detail.cancelBody: Cancel run {run}; its payables go back to wait for the next run.
detail.proposed: Run proposed — waiting for a C-Level

confirm.title: Record the bank's result for {run}
confirm.description: Enter the bank's result per item, or attach the bank's result file. Paid items get a payment voucher number and are posted.
confirm.confirmLines: Record the result of {run}: {paid} paid, {failed} failed. The postings and 50 Tawi certificates are made straight away.
confirm.confirmFile: Record the result of {run} from {name}. The postings and 50 Tawi certificates are made straight away.
confirm.drop: Drop a file here or choose one

itemDocuments.title: Documents of {pv}
itemDocuments.noWht: Nothing was withheld on this item

exceptionsPage.title: Payout exceptions
exceptionsPage.description: Failed transfers, and items left out for a missing verified bank account.

cashPage.title: Bank and cash
cashPage.description: The books against the bank statements, the matching work, and money whose payer is not known yet.

cash.title: Daily cash position
cash.description: Each bank account's balance in the books beside the last statement balance and what is still unmatched.
cash.clearingNote: Gateway and slip money waiting for its bank line (1131–1133), and receipts whose payer is not known (1140).

lines.title: Bank matching
lines.description: Statement lines not yet explained. Automatic matching uses amount, reference and a date window; the rest needs a person.
lines.search: Search by description, reference or amount

sheet.title: Bank line
sheet.suggestionsNote: By amount, reference and date window. Pick several to split this line.
sheet.noSuggestionsBody: Money in from an unknown payer can be parked as an unidentified receipt.

confirm.matchBody: Match the bank line of {line} to {target} ({amount}). The posting follows the kind of item.
confirm.splitBody: Split the bank line of {line} across {count} items; the parts must add up to the line.
confirm.unidentifiedBody: Park {amount} in unidentified receipts (1140, P29) until the payer is known.
confirm.ignoreTitle: Nothing to post for this line
confirm.ignoreBody: The line of {amount} is not a transaction to post, e.g. a transfer between the company's own accounts already recorded.

import.title: Import bank and gateway files
import.description: Bank statements, and the SCB / 2C2P settlement reports with their fees.
import.statementNote: A file already imported is refused; lines overlapping an earlier file are skipped. New lines are matched automatically at once.
import.fileHint: Columns: date,description,reference,amount,balance (negative amounts are money out)

settlement.title: Gateway settlement report
settlement.description: Posted (P04) when its bank line is found: the net to the bank, the fee to expense, the VAT on the fee to input VAT with the gateway's tax invoice.
settlement.vatHint: As on the fee tax invoice
settlement.rowsHint: One line per payment: gateway reference,gross,fee
settlement.badRows: Every line needs a reference, a gross amount and a fee
settlement.badVat: Enter the VAT on fees as a number
settlement.imported: Imported; {net} THB to the bank, waiting for its bank line

import.drop: Drop a file here or choose one

unidentifiedPage.title: Unidentified receipts
unidentifiedPage.description: Money in that no order claims yet, parked in 1140 until Finance finds the payer (P29).

identifyForm.title: Whose is {amount}?
identifyForm.description: Choose the order group this money pays. It must match the instalment due; its tax invoice / receipt is issued.
identifyForm.searchHint: Order or group code, customer name or phone
identifyForm.confirmBody: Record {amount} as a payment of {group} ({order}). Its tax invoice / receipt is issued and it leaves the clearing account.

accountsPage.title: Company bank accounts
accountsPage.description: Each tied to its own ledger account; only the last 4 digits are shown.

accounts.title: Company bank accounts
accounts.description: A new account is usable after two approvers (Finance, then Finance Manager — D-169).

form.title: Propose a company bank account
form.description: The number is stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.dual: Finance and a Finance Manager (two different people) approve it before use.
form.name: Account name
form.glHint: A bank account 112x not tied to another account
form.needFields: Enter the account name and number
